captions_note: built with CAPTIONS=0, so the reel's own captions carry the words. The phone sits beside the head; if build.py prints that it reaches the caption band, make it smaller (PHONE_W) or raise it (PHONE_TOP)
in_a_reel: set IN_FRAME a few frames after the slot starts and OUT_FRAME at least 14 frames before it ends (the phone is gone 12 frames after OUT_FRAME), so both edges are the plain picture
keep GRADE = 'none' (the reel owns the look)
the packaged card shows only words the speaker says in the clip: no numbers, names or claims that are not theirs
steps: do ask the buyer what goes on the phone: their own screen recording or picture (copy it into <slot>/screen/ and set SCREEN), or the packaged card typed from what they say in the clip (SCREEN = None, replace every placeholder). Only a screen that is theirs to show. Neither a file nor words that fit a card = no Phone Mockup: leave it out and say so
run measure.py      # every word with the frame a tap would land on, where the speaker is
edit copy the buyer's file into screen/ (if any), edit the CLIP block in build.py
run prep.py      # soft cutout for the dark phone (+ the screen file cut to the slot), about 1 min
run build.py SAFE=1 CAPTIONS=0      # prints side, size, bounds, tap frames, warnings (!!) and snapshot times
run check.py      # frame count, plain first / last frame, safe zone, tap points, sheet, stills, phone copy

buyer_folder.name: screen
buyer_folder.what: optional: the buyer's own screen recording (mp4, mov, webm) or picture (png, jpg) for the phone. Empty = the packaged card with the buyer's words
